New GTA 6 locations revealed:

A song titled "Welcome To Vice City" has appeared in the MLC music database

- Leonida is so massive that reviewers had to request maps from Rockstar multiple times to locate specific content

“Never say never, but there’s still so much to do in America,” he told The Guardian

A new GTA 6 announcement is highly possible today, since it’s the last Thursday before launch.

This is also our final GTA Online event before November 19th.

Rockstar sent creators an email with the event details yesterday, ending with “See you in Leonida.”

Rockstar has transformed the Caribbean Club in Key Largo, Florida to the GTA 6 version, The Rusty Anchor in Key Lento.

(via u/Snak3D0ct0r)
GTA 6 is officially 1 week out from launch.
